_comment: site_f: the DEDICATED FALSE-POSITIVE SUITE. A well-built developer-tools /
documentation site that deliberately carries every construct known to trip a
naive auditor, each of which is CORRECT and must NOT be reported:
* a cookie/consent banner wired to show on load  -> NOT an entry interstitial
* a muted, playsinline autoplay demo video        -> NOT autoplay-with-sound
* an XML sitemap response                         -> gets NO HTML-page checks
* an X-Robots-Tag: noindex on that sitemap        -> NOT noindex-on-content
* a newsletter sign-up in the FOOTER (plain form) -> NOT an entry overlay
* a /login page (utility)                         -> gets NO product/CTA/heading checks
* a free tool page that states no numeric price   -> NOT 'no cost signal' (it says free)
Expected outcome: ZERO findings at high or critical severity, and NONE of the
false-positive-prone checks above fire. Asserted by tests/run_offline.py
--assert-clean and by the dedicated block in tests/test_suppression.py.
Routes not listed return default_status with not_found_file.
